After some personal testing, changing some source code,

It fixed the following question.

Known Issues

  • Starting a raid on a headless FIKA instance may cause a break.

Code Adjustments

Class: TraderBundleManager
Method: UnloadAllBundles

  • Replaced synchronous bundle unload with asynchronous version:

    kvp.Value.Unload(true)

    ➜

    await kvp.Value.UnloadAsync(true)

  • Then removed yield inside the foreach loop:

    await Task.Yield();

comments.author: TheSunGod
comments.body_html:
This mod is the source of a very annoying, recurring “Matching Error”.

Very often (sometimes multiple times in a row) whoever has this mod installed will get a “matching error” when trying to start up/join a FIKA raid. It does not matter who has/does not have it installed (at one point everyone in the group had it, then we removed it, but one person forgot, and then that one person continued getting the error no matter if they were starting or joining raids). Especially infiuriating when playing on a remote hosted server and headless, since the raid would then break for that person, rendering it impossible to rejoin, and forcing to restart the headless client every single time.

Despite multiple attempts at combing logs and coming up with fixes, both with human brain and power of Claude, we were not able to pinpoint the exact source of the issue, or get it fixed.

Removed the mod, and the error never happened again.

Yes, i know the description states that it has an issue with headless, BUT the error was happening even when using it on a locally hosted server without headless, just was not nearly as gamebreaking - it was possible to just immediately try hosting again.

Mr Tarkin, i love you and your mods, this one is so great and immersive - i’d love to continue using it, but this issue renders it essentially unusable for us. Please fix.
